repo_grounded_facts.statement: SCS curve-number runoff: Q = (P - Ia)^2 / (P - Ia + S) when P > Ia, else Q = 0; S = 1000/CN - 10 (inches); Ia = 0.2 * S; valid CN in (0, 100]. 1 in/hr of runoff over 1 sq mi = 645.33 cfs.

Hydrologic datum rule: WSE_NAVD88 = gage height + validated gage zero. Without a validated station/product-specific conversion, the value is reported with verticalReference GAGE_DATUM (source datum only) and no conversion is applied.

Gauge reading freshness statuses: current | stale | unavailable | candidate. Missing data is never interpolated: the scenario runner returns triggered = 'unknown' with observed = null when a metric cannot be computed — an unknown rule is never silently false.
